name: AppShell
description: Mortar application app shell, using central semantic tokens. An optional aside adds a secondary column (multi-column layout).

contract.usage: Import { AppShell } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
